layer1.name: Binpress
layer1.one_liner: A marketplace where developers sell source code components and plugins.
layer1.description: Developers listed reusable components with licensing handled by the platform; other developers bought them rather than building from scratch. Binpress took a commission on each sale.
layer1.outcome_note: Shut down after failing to build enough liquidity on either side of the marketplace, in a category where the free alternative — open source — kept improving.
